title: A Fourier-based Framework for Domain Generalization (FACT); see also arxiv:2108.08487 Amplitude-Phase Recombination
mechanism: Amplitude-spectrum mixing between images plus a co-teacher consistency between original and mixed views, so the model relies on phase (structure) rather than amplitude (style).
adaptation: Treat the 5 sources as domains: mix amplitudes across ARTS / CFVS / CSIR / BMRK / SDLE and with pool cells; keep masks. Aimed at E1 and at the weak BMRK and CFVS sources.
min_experiment: Arm: house + cross-source amplitude mix + consistency, 5 seeds. Baseline: house. Metric: E1 crack relF1@2, BMRK crack IoU. Kill: E1 < +0.02 and BMRK < +0.03.
evidence: R: state of the art on three domain-generalisation classification benchmarks. APR (ICCV 2021): gains in corruption robustness and OOD. No segmentation or EL numbers.
prior_overlap: none. Section 5 used brightness / contrast augmentation only.
